description: Source code for a backend subtitle processing platform that includes transcription using whisperx, language detection, translation via local M2M100 model, subtitle alignment, text correction, and subtitle file generation (SRT/VTT). The file defines functions to generate subtitles from videos and to align existing subtitles with transcriptions, with many configurable settings.

methods.name: str _detect_language(text: str)
methods.description: Detects language of given text using langid with fallback to 'en'.

methods.name: str _normalize_lang_code(lang: str)
methods.description: Normalizes language code string to lowercase.

methods.name: str _ensure_supported_format(fmt: str)
methods.description: Ensures subtitle format is either 'srt' or 'vtt'.

methods.name: str _determine_output_path_with_subtitle_suffix(video_path: str, fmt: str)
methods.description: Generates output filename with subtitle suffix based on video filename.

methods.name: str _format_ts_srt(seconds: float)
methods.description: Formats time in seconds as 'hh:MM:SS,mmm' for SRT.

methods.name: str _format_ts_vtt(seconds: float)
methods.description: Formats time in seconds as 'hh:MM:SS.mmm' for VTT.

methods.name: str _format_segments_as_srt(segments: List[Dict])
methods.description: Converts segments into SRT formatted string.

methods.name: str _format_segments_as_vtt(segments: List[Dict])
methods.description: Converts segments into VTT formatted string.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Dict],str] _transcribe_with_whisperx(video_path: str)
methods.description: Transcribes video using whisperx, with a fallback stub for CI. Returns segments and detected language.

methods.name: List[Dict] _translate_segments_with_m2m100_local( segments: List[Dict], source_lang: str, target_lang: str, )
methods.description: Translates segments using local M2M100 model if available, otherwise appends language code.

methods.name: List[Dict] _segments_to_subtitle_cues(segments: List[Dict], fmt: str)
methods.description: Converts segments into a list of cue dictionaries for further processing.

methods.name: str _compose_from_cues(cues: List[Dict], fmt: str)
methods.description: Converts cues into subtitle content string based on format.

methods.name: str generate_subtitle(video_path: str, subtitle_lang: str, format: str)
methods.description: Main function to generate subtitle file from video, performing transcription, language detection, translation, alignment, correction, and output file writing.

methods.name: str process_and_align_subtitles( video_path: str, existing_subtitle_cues: List[Dict], output_format: str = "srt", language_hint: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Aligns existing subtitles with transcribed content from video, corrects, and exports.

ctags.signature: ( segments: List[Dict], source_lang: str, target_lang: str, )

ctags.name: generate_subtitle
ctags.pattern: /^def generate_subtitle(video_path: str, subtitle_lang: str, format: str) -> str:$/

ctags.signature: ( video_path: str, existing_subtitle_cues: List[Dict], output_format: str = "srt", language_hint: Optional[str] = None, )
